name: People Analytics
description: Organizations worldwide are transforming, creating challenges such as managing virtual workforces and retaining talent. To prepare HR for this evolving landscape, it is essential to emphasize data analytics, an aspect often overlooked in traditional HR education. This course is designed to equip participants with the foundational skills necessary for comprehending data in human resource management.
